description: The Forgotten Library of Ashenmoor — a crumbling ancient vault buried beneath a ruined tower. Dusty bookshelves stretch toward a vaulted ceiling lost in shadow. Bioluminescent moss clings to the stone walls, casting a cold blue-green glow. The air smells of old parchment, mildew, and something faintly arcane. A heavy iron door stands at the far end, sealed with a glowing rune. Strange whispers drift between the shelves.
